[SWS_CM_80017] Data accumulation for
UDP
data transmission
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
To allow for the transmission of multiple messages (SOME/IP event, SOME/IP method
request, SOME/IP method response, signal-based event, and signal-based field noti-
fier) within a single
UDP
datagram, data accumulation for
UDP
data transmission shall
be supported.
⌋
